label: Move mouse
description: Move the mouse on the computer's screen without clicking, to hover over something. `args` is `{ x, y, modifiers }`: `x` and `y` in screen pixels, `modifiers` keys held during the move, joined by + (optional).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Where to move, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `move` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Move the mouse without clicking, to hover over something.
anthropic.name: mouse_move

coordinate.description: Where to move as [x, y], pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

text.description: Keys to hold down during the action, joined by + (shift, ctrl+shift).

openai.description: Move the mouse without clicking, to hover over something.
openai.name: move

keys.description: Keys to hold down during the action, like ["SHIFT"] or ["CTRL", "SHIFT"].

x.description: Where to move, across, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

y.description: Where to move, down, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.
